jsonTools.label: Usage Risks

catalog.title: USAGE RISKS
catalog.desc: Commercial IT scan — extracts every operational constraint (SLAs, seat caps, rate limits, notice periods, audit terms) that governs how Colgate uses the product or service.

engine.urBuildPrompt:
function urBuildPrompt(text) {
  return [
    "You are a Commercial IT Analyst at Colgate-Palmolive. Your job is to",
    "extract a COMPLETE operational profile of what Colgate is buying — every",
    "constraint, limit, deadline, threshold, or rule that governs HOW Colgate",
    "uses the product/service or interacts with the vendor.",
    "",
    "CRITICAL RULES — PROTECT COLGATE:",
    "1. PERSPECTIVE: You work FOR Colgate. Every finding must be something",
    "   that COULD NEGATIVELY IMPACT Colgate — create cost, risk, restriction,",
    "   obligation, lock-in, exposure, or operational headache. Skip ANYTHING",
    "   that is neutral or favorable to Colgate (e.g., vendor commits to",
    "   99.9% uptime — Colgate's benefit, NOT a usage risk; vendor gives",
    "   Colgate 90 days termination notice — Colgate's right, NOT a constraint).",
    "2. IGNORE obligations placed solely on the vendor / counterparty. Only",
    "   flag rules COLGATE must follow or limits that apply to COLGATE.",
    "3. Examples of items that DO impact Colgate negatively (flag these):",
    "   API rate limits / overage fees, seat caps, notice periods Colgate must",
    "   give, auto-renewal lock-in, termination-for-convenience deadlines",
    "   Colgate must hit, audit response windows, data residency restrictions,",
    "   usage reporting cadence, MFA mandates Colgate must implement, browser/OS",
    "   compatibility limits, certificate rotation Colgate must maintain,",
    "   breach notification deadlines on Colgate, throttling rules, change-",
    "   control procedures Colgate must follow, vendor-mandated tools/integrations.",
    "4. DO NOT flag legal-style risks (indemnity, IP, liability caps,",
    "   warranties) — those belong to a different scan.",
    "5. The document is provided below as a JSON array of paragraphs, each",
    "   with an `id` (format `ELI_IDX_<n>`) and `text`. When you find a",
    "   constraint, return the EXACT id of the paragraph where it lives.",
    "   This id is how Colgate's ELI tooling jumps to and edits the clause.",
    "",
    "OUTPUT — JSON object with one key `items`, value is an array of:",
    "{",
    '  "id":         "ELI_IDX_<n>   — REQUIRED — exact paragraph id from input",',
    '  "topic":      "Short topic name (e.g. \\"API Rate Limit\\", \\"Auto-Renewal\\")",',
    '  "detail":     "The specific constraint, in plain language",',
    '  "impact":     "Operational impact on Colgate (1-2 sentences)",',
    '  "watchout":   "The single biggest danger if Colgate misses or misreads this",',
    '  "suggestion": "Concrete mitigation: re-negotiate cap, pre-purchase,',
    '                add notice cushion, request carve-out, etc.",',
    '  "quote":      "Verbatim short snippet from the paragraph (≤ 220 chars)"',
    "}",
    "",
    "If no usage constraints exist, return: { \"items\": [], \"overview\":",
    "\"No operational constraints detected.\" }. Otherwise include a 1-2",
    "sentence `overview` field summarizing the operational profile (e.g.",
    '"Vendor-tight SaaS subscription: hard seat cap, 30-day notice, EU-only',
    'data hosting.").',
    "",
    "Be concise — no preamble, no markdown code fence, JSON only.",
    "",
    "PARAGRAPHS:",
    String(text || "").substring(0, 500000),
  ].join("\n");
}

// Normalize AI response → canonical { items: [...] } shape with
// ELI_IDX_<n> id, severity, and stripped redline markers (defensive —
// usage_risks scans clean paragraph text, but a tracker / redline-aware
// caller could feed the same shape future-proof).
